name: seip25/lila-php
description: Ultra-fast, zero-dependency PHP 8.4+ micro-API framework with decoupled static frontend, Lila.js reactive SPA engine, Bluebird CSS, multi-driver DB, and universal AI engine (DeepSeek, Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, Ollama).

suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Required for MySQL database connection pooling.
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: Optional for portable SQLite database storage.
suggest.ext-apcu: Recommended for zero-latency shared RAM caching.
suggest.ext-redis: Recommended for distributed caching and background job queues.
suggest.ext-opcache: Required for permanent in-memory preloading in production.
suggest.ext-curl: Required for Core\Http client and Core\AI LLM requests.
